## Standard Operating Procedure – *NGI’s Daily Gas Price Index*

### Purpose

This document is a step-by-step guide to building, proofreading and publishing [*NGI’s Daily Gas Price Index*](https://www.naturalgasintel.com/news/daily-gas-price-index/), including internal communication procedures between teams. 

### Context

Around 3 p.m. ET, editorial accounts for what stories have been posted every day and arranges them in the order they should appear in the DGPI e-newsletter and PDF. The absolute final deadline for posting stories and sending DGPI to layout is 4 p.m. ET, but on most days, all stories are live by 3 p.m. ET.

### How to Prep DGPI for Layout

#### Sending the DGPI layout to the Layout Team:

1. At 3 p.m., ask editorial in Slack: “@here does anything else need to go up today for DGPI?” 

2. Ensure all stories (except market) have been posted *with PDF subject heads and layout notes* (see [How to Post an Article](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1ssRN5FzJGCrMpKHofzN9pASycU_x2phwhXp9UHqT4l8/edit?usp=drive_link) for PDF subject heds)*.* 

   1. Note: Certain MX+ stories may use images that are already included in the appendix of DGPI. If this is the case, note as such by editing the PDF layout notes in the backend of an article. 

3. Create a document containing the DGPI story lineup copied and pasted from the DGPI order email (example [here](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1iW-Msw10aX47G1EhARAlQTsUjpQlG9waUtLb-mkzzUg/edit?usp=sharing)). 

4. From the [Wagtail Admin](https://www.naturalgasintel.com/ngi-editor-admin/), which can be accessed by selecting the Wagtail bird in the lower right hand corner of the website, click Newsletters from the purple menu on the left side of the screen. Click Add Newsletter. Select Daily GPI Newsletter from the list of options. 

5. Title the newsletter as “dgYYYYMMDD.” 

   1. The day should be set for the *following* work day. For example, if you are sending out DGPI on the evening of April 1, you would title the newsletter “dg20240402,” *even though the newsletter will arrive in the inboxes of DGPI subscribers on April 1*. 

6. Under Stories, select the stories from the DGPI story lineup *in order* (the Futures Settle market story will go in the Story of the day slot above the Stories section, but since it will not yet have been posted, ignore that slot). 

7. The Newsletter Date should match the Title date; i.e., it should be set for the following  work day. 

8. Email scheduled datetime schedules when the email would be sent via Magnet Mail to subscribers. Select Send Now.

9. Layout Recipients should automatically be set for the [layout@naturalgasintel.com](mailto:layout@naturalgasintel.com) email. 

   1. **ICE: If the layout email does not go through within 3 minutes, in the Layout Recipients box, put in your own email, Save Draft, and resend to yourself. Then, *forward the layout file to [layout@naturalgasintel.com](mailto:layout@naturalgasintel.com)* once the email comes through.** 

10. General Layout Notes should include a note with the volume  and issue number of DGPI as well as:

    1. …if there is an Offtake segment (which must be Story No. 5 in lineup), note that as well if you did not already do so in the article. 

    2. …note that there will be a Futures Settle story at spot \#1 and a Spot Prices Wrap story at spot \#4. 

       1. Those stories will be sent in two subsequent layout files. 

    3. …if there is a holiday notice, add it to the General Layout Notes 

11. Click Save draft

12. **In the Preview view, ensure that all stories have PDF subject heads. If not, see step 13 in [Article Posting SOP](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1ssRN5FzJGCrMpKHofzN9pASycU_x2phwhXp9UHqT4l8/edit?usp=sharing)**

![][image1]

13. Click Send Layout Email, which will send the HTML order to the layout team member generating the PDF. 

14. Check email inbox to ensure HTML has been sent.


### Once Futures Settle Is Posted

1. From the newsletter you were working on, click Save draft to refresh the page, *then* add in the Futures Settle story to the Story of the Day section, selecting the most recent Futures Settle story and ensuring that it is the correct story that you just posted.. 

   1. If you exited the tab where you were working on the DGPI newsletter, you can find the newsletter from your Admin homepage under Your Recent Edits. 

2. The Email Subject line will also be automatically filled in with the title of the market story at this point. 

   1. **Edit the Email Subject line to remove “Futures Settle: ” from the start of the headline.** 

3. Click Save Draft again. 

4. Click Send Layout Email — again

   1. Sometimes a “Re-export HTML” button will appear instead of “Send Layout Email.” That option should also send the layout email. 

5. Check email inbox to ensure HTML has been sent

### Once Spot Prices Wrap Is Posted

1. Save draft to refresh your page, then under Stories, select the most recent Spot Prices Wrap story and move it to spot \#4 (below the first two stories in the Stories section).  **Ensure that it is the correct story that you just posted.**

2. Save draft

3. Click Send Layout Email for the final time.  

### Once the PDF Is Sent Back

1. Proofread the PDF using [this guide](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Qrgs82iBWF4X9G5drvCzbUlcHQ6NCTERZlJxEOWqpJ4/edit?usp=sharing). 

2. Respond to the layout team member whether the PDF looks good/needs tweaks. 

   1. Note any corrections needed with their page number and/or screenshots for clarification. 

3. From the newsletter you were working on, next to Newsletter Date, select the PDF and upload the file you received. 

4. Save Draft. Review your work in the preview screen. 

5. Select Publish from the green bar at the bottom left of the screen

6. Select Send to Magnet Mail from the new screen you are taken to. 

   1. You will still have 5 minutes to make any adjustments to the newsletter once you click Send to Magnet Mail. 

   2. If you need to make any adjustments, reclick the button that turned to Remove from Magnet Mail Queue and then Edit the newsletter. **Select Unpublish from the green box at the bottom**, then make your edits, then repeat steps 4–6. 

7. Alert editorial in Slack that “DGPI is away”

8. Email [all@naturalgasintel.com](mailto:all@naturalgasintel.com) via email that “All pubs are done for the day”

9. Double-check that you receive DGPI in your email about 10 minutes after sending to Magnet Mail. 

### In Case of Emergencies – Price Team Contacts & Problem Solving

See team schedule above for who completes what duties. Schedule varies by workload and PTO. *Someone from the price team is almost always on standby until the “All pubs done for the day” email has been sent by Editorial.* 

Images/Charts:

1. Storage Snapshot: Included in markets stories and completed on Mondays and Wednesdays (usually) early in the day by [Pat Rau](mailto:pat.rau@naturalgasintel.com), [Leticia Gonzales](mailto:leticia.gonzales@naturalgasintel.com) and [Josten Mavez](mailto:josten.mavez@naturalgasintel.com). 

2. LNG Export Flow Tracker: Page 2 of the LNG Appendix in DGPI. Along with Mexico pipeline scrapes and Rover/Rex pipeline scrapes, the LNG tracker is completed by [Josiah Clinedinst](mailto:josiah.clinedinst@naturalgasintel.com). 

3. LNG Charts: These make up the rest of the LNG Appendix in DGPI and are mostly completed by [Josten Mavez](mailto:josten.mavez@naturalgasintel.com) and [Josiah Clinedinst](mailto:josiah.clinedinst@naturalgasintel.com). Work begins in the morning, and around 4:45 EST, J\&J will begin finalizing the LNG charts. All should be uploaded to Dropbox by 5:45 EST. Editorial members should receive email updates around that time. 

   1. If the Layout Team emails [trouble@naturalgasintel.com](mailto:trouble@naturalgasintel.com) saying LNG images have not been uploaded, they should first refresh their Dropbox folder. 

   2. If Layout Team has refreshed Dropbox and files are still old, then the Editorial Team member on DGPI duty that evening could run the [Airflow](https://airflow.ngi-internal.com/home) orchestrator for “Daily\_GPI\_Dropbox\_Automation” to see where an error may have occurred. 

   3. If the Editorial Team member on DGPI duty does not have access to Airflow, contact [trouble@naturalgasintel.com](mailto:trouble@naturalgasintel.com) informing team members which charts are missing and that Layout has refreshed Dropbox. 

4. Price Charts & Tables: [Leticia Gonzales](mailto:leticia.gonzales@naturalgasintel.com)checks Daily, Shale and Mexico prices and is done around 4:45 EST. The CME data also is completed and uploaded to Dropbox at that time. 

   1. The CME futures table (p. 4\) and the previous 5-day table (p. 1\) are tied to the CME data. If data has not been uploaded, those charts may be old.
